en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Qasim Al Sayrafi, from Hafs Bin Al Qasim who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon the height of every bridge is a devil<sup>la</sup>. So whenever you end up to it, say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, he<sup>la</sup> would move away from you’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Qasim al-Sayrafiy from Hafs ibn al-Qasim who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘On every bridge there is a Satan. When you approach him, say, ‘(I seek help) by the name of Allah.’ He moves away from you.’”
